name: Partnerships & Deals
question: Do the company's partnerships, contracts, and M&A actually move revenue, capability, or distribution — or are they press-release assets?

signals.description: New partnerships/contracts with disclosed economics; LLM classifies: economics disclosed? binding? exclusive?
Partner-side confirmation and prominence — search from the partner's side: does the partner also announce it? Independence rule.
Renewals vs quiet lapses of past deals; deal ledger follow-up searches at renewal windows

recipe.query_template: {company} renews OR extends OR ends partnership

signals.description: M&A track record: integration success, goodwill impairments; filings + news history per acquisition
Customer-concentration risk in contracts; filings extraction

Announcement-ledger follow-through rate for deals/partnerships: share of dated commitments delivered on time (§4.4). Fed by the forward-only ledger (WP6.1), NOT searched — this signal is injected at grading time from ledger.followThroughRate; the recipe is a placeholder and monitor_feed recipes are skipped by report-run research.

recipe.query_template: {company} announced deal OR partnership delivered on time

grade_anchors.A: Deals have disclosed economics, partner-side confirmation, and later show up in results; acquisitions integrate without impairment.
grade_anchors.C: Mix of substantive and promotional deals; one aging unconfirmed "strategic partnership."
grade_anchors.F: Deal-flow is press-release theater: undisclosed economics, no partner-side confirmation, serial acquisitions writing down goodwill.

false_signals.description: "Partnership with {BigTech}" that is actually a standard vendor/reseller agreement. Check partner's own announcement (absent = flag), check disclosed economics (absent = flag).

recipe.query_template: {partner} announcement OR press release about {company} partnership

false_signals.description: Company invests in an entity that becomes a "customer" (revenue round-tripping). Agent run cross-referencing investment announcements vs new-customer announcements. Confirmed hit caps the composite at C and pins a red banner (§4.3).

recipe.query_template: {company} investment announcements cross-referenced against new-customer announcements

false_signals.description: Non-binding memoranda counted in "pipeline" or implied backlog. Language classification of deal announcements (binding vs intent).

recipe.query_template: {company} memorandum of understanding OR MOU OR letter of intent pipeline

false_signals.description: Growth entirely from roll-ups. Filings extraction separating organic vs acquired revenue where disclosed; flag when not disclosed.

evidence_policy.notes: This dimension is largely made of its false-signal screen; the deal ledger (§4.4) feeds follow-through once tracking accrues (WP6.1). {partner} resolves per announced deal at research time.
